title: Hurricane Maria: Food for Isolated Puerto Ricans in Utaudo
description: The U. S. Department of Homeland Security deliver food and water to isolated Puerto Ricans due to their bridge being destroyed by Hurricane Maria in the mountains around Utuado; and Marilyn “Lily” Lucinao tells the story of her daughter, Kayshla Rodriguez, crossing the river to see her, Puerto Rico, Oct. 12, 2017. The Federal Emergency Management Agency and its federal partners continue 24-hour operations to conduct life-saving rescue and medical missions. (US Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Franklin Harris)
keywords: Homeland Security, FEMA, Maria, Ice, 1CTCS, UH-60 Blackhawk, 1st Combat Camera Squadron, Hurricane Maria, VIPR, Utaudo, Virgin Islands Puerto Rico, water, COMCAM, Black Hawk, blackhawk, food
